svg.title: A Powers factor inside the specified periodic modular flow
svg.desc: For a periodic state, successive commutants supply commuting two by two matrix blocks with weights lambda over one plus lambda and one over one plus lambda. Their increasing finite heads generate a normal Powers factor with the same modular eigenvalue lambda to the it on each e12. For infinite weight, fixed centralizer matrix coordinates give M as B of ell squared tensor a finite-weight corner. The constructed subfactor is B of ell squared tensor the Powers factor, with weight a times Tr tensor omega lambda.

g.text: The original modular flow on every matrix head
σψ(t)(e₁₂ in Dₙ) = λⁱᵗ e₁₂ in Dₙ
Exact commuting blocks; their product-state GNS unitary identifies the entire normal closure.
Infinite mass: choose fixed centralizer coordinates vᵢ
φ = a Tr ⊗ ψp; a = φ(p)
φ restricted to R = a Tr ⊗ ωλ
The restriction is semifinite. R is AFD of type IIIλ; the ambient factor need not be AFD.
